mizoramDefect.description: 5 Mizoram statutory assembly seats (AC 31-35) with unrecorded voter counts preserved as NULL without zero-fabrication

defects.workstream: Workstream A: Final Schema and Migration Correctness
defects.summary: Forward-only Migration 069 and DDL reconciliation of machine-readable schema contract specification
defects.directiveRequirement: Reconcile organization_relationships column names (source_org_id, target_org_id per Migration 050 DDL); add forward-only Migration 069 after Migration 068 to idempotently reconcile candidacies foreign keys (ON DELETE RESTRICT) and deduplicate redundant indexes; update schema contract specification with Migration 069 SHA-256 and truthful sourceCommit.
defects.remediationDetails: Authored supabase/migrations/069_candidate_referential_integrity_reconciliation.sql: idempotently drops legacy candidacies_contest_id_fkey (CASCADE) and legacy unnamed FKs; creates named RESTRICT constraints fk_candidacies_contest, fk_candidacies_person, fk_candidacies_party; drops duplicate indexes idx_candidacies_contest_fk, idx_candidacies_person_fk, idx_candidacies_party_fk while ensuring canonical base indexes exist. Reconciled reports/w021_5_schema_contract_specification.json: corrected organization_relationships columns to source_org_id and target_org_id; updated migration sequence to 15 files including Migration 069 (SHA-256: 584f88effe438ace59f3a7acd6d9bfe925b7307f95a042e5477ae5d91f68d678); updated sourceCommit to 28aa5e808a937c61b466aac3c456a97090a6656d; updated scripts/lib/stagingExecutionPlan.mjs.

defects.workstream: Workstream B: Operational Stage 1 Idempotency & Database Constraint Alignment
defects.summary: Correction of natural keys, temporal trigger invariants, non-key mutation policy, and operational runner integration for Stage 1
defects.directiveRequirement: Align organization_symbols natural key with committed unique constraint uq_org_symbols_timeline (organization_id, symbol_name, valid_from) without jurisdiction_scope; enforce temporal non-overlap for organization_aliases across organizations under trigger fn_validate_org_alias_temporal_invariants; establish explicit STAGE1_MUTATION_POLICY; integrate reconciler into scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs; reconcile exact child row arithmetic (1,099 child rows + 107 orgs + 1 prov = 1,207 catalog records).
defects.remediationDetails: Updated scripts/lib/stage1IdempotentReconciler.mjs: 1) organization_symbols natural key strictly uses (organization_id, symbol_name, valid_from); 2) organization_aliases checks cross-organization temporal collisions and flags TEMPORAL_TRIGGER_COLLISION; 3) established STAGE1_MUTATION_POLICY with protected statutory/temporal attributes; 4) integrated into executeStage1Staging in scripts/execute_staging_directive_139.mjs; 5) verified exact arithmetic: 10 relationships + 27 multilingual + 19 symbols + 1,043 aliases = 1,099 child rows (eliminating references to 1,100). Updated tests/stage1-idempotent-reconciler.test.mjs with 7/7 tests passing.

defects.workstream: Workstream C: Actual Canonical Constituency Identity (Task E-01)
defects.summary: Delineation of statutory codes, proposed RFC 4122 UUIDv5, and live target database internal_id resolution
defects.directiveRequirement: Do not report UUIDv5 as live target UUID. Establish relationship between statutory identity, canonical row, internal_id, canonical code, and delimitation period. Define target internal_id resolution method and account for 134-seat demographic manifest gap, 153 non-statutory entries, and 5-seat Mizoram defect.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated scripts/build_constituency_4123_crosswalk.mjs and reports/w021_5_constituency_4123_crosswalk.json: clearly separates statutoryCompositeCode ('AP-AC-1'), canonicalCode ('AP-AC-001'), reproducibleNamespaceUuid (UUIDv5), and targetInternalUuid (null, status: PENDING_TARGET_DATABASE_RESOLUTION). Documented exact target database SQL resolution: SELECT id, internal_id, canonical_code, state_code, constituency_number FROM public.constituencies. Delineated 134-seat statutory manifest gap, 153 non-statutory entries, and DQ-W021.5-B2.2E-001. Stage 3 dispatch strictly blocked from staging with 0 rows outbound until live resolution is corroborated.

defects.workstream: Workstream D: Canonical Election/Contest Identity & Schema Reconciliation (Task F-02)
defects.summary: Architecture reconciliation between normalized UUID models and legacy integer election_results
defects.directiveRequirement: Resolve schema mismatch between legacy public.election_results (integer election_id) and normalized public.election_contests (UUID). Zero UUID casting into integer columns. Establish canonical election_events and election_contests entities before binding results. Support 2014 J&K 87 statutory seats and uncontested seats.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated scripts/build_canonical_election_registry.mjs and reports/w021_5_canonical_election_registry.json: established architectural reconciliation where normalized public.election_events and public.election_contests (UUID) are the primary authoritative store, candidacies bind via contest_id, and legacy compatibility is provided via public.vw_legacy_election_results without UUID-to-integer casting. Built 23-state election and 2,243-contest registry covering statutory delimitation regimes (including 2014 J&K 87-seat statutory scope and Arunachal AC-4, AC-16, AC-31 uncontested seats). Stage 4 dispatch remains blocked with 0 rows outbound until canonical events/contests are seeded in target database.

defects.workstream: Workstream E: Real Staging Containment & Independent Authorization
defects.summary: Staging write-gating security, administrator containment confirmation, and independent cryptographic authorization token
defects.directiveRequirement: Staging execution may proceed only after genuine administrator containment confirmation, verified protected trust anchor, and independently signed authorization token. If prerequisites remain unprovisioned, fail closed with PARTIALLY_READY_WITH_BLOCKED_STAGES and exact outstanding actions.
defects.remediationDetails: Audited staging containment and authorization prerequisites: containment remains CONTAINMENT_PENDING_ADMIN_CONFIRMATION; authorization token remains BLOCKED_NO_CTO_TOKEN. Enforced strict fail-closed boundary: staging mutations remain strictly 0; production air-gap preserved with 0 queries and 0 mutations. Reported exact outstanding administrative actions in reports/w021_5_staging_execution_report.json.

defects.workstream: Workstream F: External Evidence Blocker Dispositions (EB-01 to EB-06)
defects.summary: Authoritative evidence acquisition, digital publication verification, custodian status, and Rule IV-001 adjudication
defects.directiveRequirement: Pursue EB-01 through EB-06 with authoritative sources; distinguish digital verification from physical certified copy custody; evaluate PIN boundary GeoJSON vs postman delivery beats; provide reproducible spatial containment and polling station crosswalk; obtain independent adjudication.
defects.remediationDetails: Updated external evidence package: EB-01 (official gazette inventory with official ECI digital URLs, SHA-256 hashes, physical copy custody noted as custodian responsibility); EB-02 (reproducible digital transcription comparisons, physical comparison noted); EB-03 (OGD PIN code boundary GeoJSON assessed as 6-digit postal delivery areas, not delivery beats; DoP inquiry logged); EB-04 (reproducible spatial analysis with EPSG:4326/7755 CRS); EB-05 (polling station crosswalk framework with station/part hierarchy and CEO portal status); EB-06 (independent adjudication required; formal CTO acceptance remains strictly 0.0% under Rule IV-001 Non-Self-Acceptance).
